sentences.en: Volcanic eruptions in Tonga have created a new island.
sentences.zh: 汤加火山爆发形成了一个新的岛屿。

sentences.en: The eruption of the volcano Vesuvius destroyed the city of Pompeii.
sentences.zh: 维苏威火山的喷发摧毁了庞贝城。

sentences.en: History has recorded many violent volcanic eruptions on Earth.
sentences.zh: 历史上记录了许多地球上剧烈的火山爆发。

senses.zh: （火山）喷发；（战争，感情等）爆发，迸发
